body.en: The shared 80 is not a shared output. Electric 80 lists a 110 kW motor, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa and distance 900 m / 300 m, with aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Theoretical output: Electric 80 lists 60 m³/h; LZ-80 lists High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Dimensions: Electric 80 lists 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm; LZ-80 lists 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Electric 80 lists cells that LZ-80 does not: Model line Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110; Motor power 110 kW; Max. outlet pressure 40 MPa; Pumping distance (H / V) 900 m / 300 m; Main unit weight 6000 kg. Aggregate wording also differs: 24 mm (≤ 2 cm) on one page, 6 cm and below on the other. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other. Does Electric 80 list the same max. Why is model line missing on LZ-80? Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
